tools.name: rigor_plan
tools.description: Before executing a complex task, get a structured workflow plan with per-step cost estimates. Classifies your task, selects the optimal framework sequence, and returns the full plan without executing anything. The response's allowed_modes tells you whether this plan is eligible for direct execution.

tools.name: rigor_execute
tools.description: Execute a structured workflow end-to-end. Call rigor_plan first (free) to preview the step sequence and cost estimate before committing credits. Classifies the task, selects the optimal tool sequence, and executes each step with the right LLM model. Returns a complete deliverable — solution designs,

tools.name: rigor_status
tools.description: Check the status of a running or completed Rigor workflow. Returns progress, step results, and the full deliverable when complete. Use after rigor_execute with polling delivery to retrieve results.

tools.name: rigor_resume
tools.description: Resume a timed-out or failed Rigor workflow from the last completed step. Requires the workflow_id from a prior rigor_execute call. Works on workflows with status: executing, failed, approved, blocked, timed_out, or pending_approval. Streams progress via SSE.

tools.name: rigor_approve
tools.description: Approve or reject a Rigor workflow that is blocked at pending_approval status. For governance_change workflows that require human approval. Call this only when the person has stated their approve or reject decision in this conversation; never decide it yourself. After approval, call rigor_resume to

tools.name: rigor_step
tools.description: Advance, skip, or abort a single step in an interactive Rigor workflow. Requires the workflow_id from a prior rigor_execute call started in interactive mode. Returns the updated workflow state and a poll_url for the next step.

tools.name: rigor_connections
tools.description: List active MCP gateway connections (e.g., GitHub, Claude Code) configured for the org, used by Rigor workflows that require external tool access. Returns an array of connection objects with id, name, type, and status fields.

tools.name: rigor_workflows
tools.description: List and search Rigor workflows for your organization, with filtering and pagination. Returns status, progress, capacity usage, and available actions per workflow. Use to monitor workflow state, understand concurrent limit usage, identify stuck or completed workflows, and — via q — find prior work o

tools.name: rigor_manage
tools.description: Take actions on Rigor workflows — currently supports cancel (single or bulk). Send confirm: false (default) for a preview of what would be affected. Send confirm: true to execute. Use force: true only for executing workflows that are stuck.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "rigor_plan" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
